title: 第三章 、坐错位置死，真假少爷狗血剧情
slug: 末日求生欧皇女配在线摇人
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

死后在自己创造的世界复活，身份还是女主，温书琴畅快大笑，连忙收拾东西往小说故事开始的地方，首都贵族学院紫菱学校赶去，幻想自己在学校大杀四方，无数优质男人都拜倒在她石榴裙下。

可惜温书琴忘记，自己设计的女主被校园霸凌，第一次高考失利，分数线完全够不上紫菱学校。

是在复读一次之后，凭借着自己不懈努力、拼搏，以高考状元分数在首都第一贵族学院紫菱学校闪亮登场，这也为女主校园生活埋下一个炸弹。

温书琴设计这一个剧情就是为了树立原主自强不息的人设，好吸引贵族学院优质青年的注意力。

现在算是作茧自缚，她想要在故事开头前往贵族学院，将原文恶毒女配的金手指给抢了，不是没有办法，只是有些困难，需要花费大量的财富，在考入紫菱学校的平民手里购买陪读资格。

花了大价钱购买了陪读资格，还要她伏低做小伺候人，伺候不好，对方还能随时将她换掉，让其他人陪读。

温书琴就气的不行，却不得不这么做，谁让她跟原主不一样，原主能复读一次就以高考状元的身份杀入紫菱学校这个顶级学府，换做温书琴，复读无数次都可能连紫菱学校录取分数线最后一名都够不上。

这就让温书琴更加嫉恨端木棠梨，谁让她为了给端木棠梨这个只是流动水果商贩的普通女孩进入顶级学府机会，特的设计了欧皇属性，直接在奢侈品店中了特等奖，轻轻松松获得紫菱学校的录取资格。

又来了，看来二人以后的确有仇，对方恨意都不加收敛，她得离眼前的年轻女人远点，以免不知不觉中被弄死，只是不知道作为重生女，对方有没有金手指？

端木棠梨感觉到温书琴身上的杀意，心里很是无奈，她胎穿这个世界二十几年，尝试过很多办法，都没有发觉自己有除了运气好以外其他金手指。

跟有金手指的重生女对上，实在太刺激了。

“嗯嗯，你说的对，好言难劝该死诡，我就不该大发善心说那句提醒的。”

这是端木棠梨心里话，早知道倒霉男人狗咬吕洞宾，不识好人心，她根本不会开口提醒对方，害得自己被一个疑似重生的女主盯上。

可端木棠梨诚恳的话，在温书琴听来，就是变相指责说她想要害死男人，脸都黑了，却心塞发现，自己无法反驳对方。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

After her death, she was resurrected in the world she created. She was still the heroine. Wen Shuqin laughed heartily and quickly packed her things and rushed to Ziling School, the aristocratic academy in the capital, where the novel began. She imagined that she would kill everyone in the school, and countless high-quality men would fall under her pomegranate skirt.

It's a pity that Wen Shuqin forgot that the heroine he designed was bullied in school and failed the college entrance examination for the first time. Her score was completely unable to reach Ziling School.

After re-study once, with his unremitting efforts and hard work, he made his debut at Ziling School, the first aristocratic college in the capital, with the top score in the college entrance examination. This also planted a bomb for the heroine's campus life.

Wen Shuqin designed this plot to establish the original owner's self-improvement character so as to attract the attention of high-quality young people from the aristocratic academy.

Now she is trapped in a cocoon. She wants to go to the Noble Academy at the beginning of the story and snatch the golden finger of the vicious female supporting character in the original text. It is not that there is no way, but it is a bit difficult. She needs to spend a lot of wealth to buy the qualification to accompany her from the common people who are admitted to Ziling School.

She spent a lot of money to buy the qualification to accompany her as a student, and she was asked to be a lowly servant. If she didn't serve well, the other party could replace her at any time and let someone else accompany her.

Wen Shuqin was extremely angry, but she had to do this. Who made her different from the original owner. The original owner could enter Ziling School, a top school, as the top scorer in the college entrance examination after repeating the exam once. But if it were Wen Shuqin who repeated the exam countless times, she might not even be able to reach the last place in the Ziling School's admission score.

This made Wen Shuqin even more jealous of Duanmu Tangli. In order to give Duanmu Tangli, an ordinary girl who was just a mobile fruit vendor, a chance to enter a top school, she specially designed the European Emperor attribute, directly won the special prize in a luxury store, and easily obtained admission to Ziling School.

Here it comes again. It seems that the two will indeed have a grudge in the future. The other party will not restrain his hatred. She has to stay away from the young woman in front of her to avoid being killed unknowingly. But as a reborn girl, she wonders if the other party has a golden finger?

Duanmu Tangli felt the murderous intent in Wen Shuqin's body and felt helpless. She had been born in this world for more than 20 years and tried many methods, but she never realized that she had other golden fingers besides good luck.

It's so exciting to face off against a reborn girl with a golden finger.

"Yeah, you're right. It's hard to persuade someone with good words. Damn it, I shouldn't have said that reminder out of kindness."

This was what Duanmu Tangli was saying. If she had known that the unlucky man was biting Lu Dongbin and had no good heart, she would not have warned him, and she would have been targeted by a heroine who was suspected of being reborn.

But Duanmu Tangli's sincere words sounded to Wen Shuqin as a disguised accusation that she wanted to kill the man. His face turned dark, but he found that he could not refute the other party.
